values.note: $35 per night for a non-electric site, $40 for an electric site; group sites (non-electric) $120; cabins $80; equestrian sites $25. Maximum 6 people per site. Late check-out $10. First night's deposit non-refundable.

fees.source: https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/562/Camping-Cabins-Rentals ('Rate: $35 per night for a non-electric site, $40 per night for an electric site, $120 per night for group sites'), read 2026-10-21; Firefly lists 'Non-Electric Site' separately from 'Tent Only Site'

season.source: https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/499 ('Campground and Equestrian Camping: Open March 1 through November 30') + https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/562/Camping-Cabins-Rentals ('normally March 1 to November 30'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/NorthwestRiverPark (site types '20/30/50amp Electric Pull-Through', '20/30/50amp Electric Site', '20/30amp Electric Site', 'Non-Electric Site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 72 family campsites plus six group sites, 2 cabins and an equestrian area. 'Pull-through campsites are limited to trailers/RVs 25 feet or longer.' One trailer/RV and one tent per site.

sites.source: https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/562/Camping-Cabins-Rentals ('We have 72 sites for family camping and six group sites') + https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/3015/Campground-Rules-and-Regulations ('Pull-through campsites are limited to trailers/RVs 25 feet or longer') + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/NorthwestRiverPark ('20/30/50amp Electric Pull-Through'), read 2026-10-21. The 50-ft max_rig_ft (note prose) is stated on none of the city's pages or Firefly, so it is cleared.

facilities.source: https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/562/Camping-Cabins-Rentals ('Facilities include hot showers, laundry, recreation vehicle (RV) pump out, and fresh water') + https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/499 ('a well-stocked camp store' at the Welcome Center), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online through Firefly or in person at the Welcome Center, paid in full; no phone card payments. 'Reservations for campsites start January 1 for the following camping season.' 14 nights in any 30-day period. A specific site is assigned at check-in (2 p.m.); check-out noon; late check-in by prior arrangement for the gate code. The park map marks campground rentals 'Reservable; then First Come, First Served'.

booking.source: https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/562/Camping-Cabins-Rentals + https://www.cityofchesapeake.net/3015/Campground-Rules-and-Regulations ('All campground reservations are to be made either in person at the Welcome Center ... or online through the Firefly website', 'Campsite and cabin rentals are limited to 14 nights in a 30-day period'), read 2026-10-21

note: City of Chesapeake park (Parks, Recreation & Tourism) on the 763-acre Northwest River park. 72 family sites (20/30/50-amp electric and non-electric, some pull-throughs for rigs 25 ft and longer) plus six group sites, 2 cabins and an equestrian area; hot showers, laundry, fresh water, RV pump-out, camp store. Open March 1 - November 30; reservations online (Firefly) or at the Welcome Center. Wooded inland sites; river access via trail (sites not on the water). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city's pages and Firefly: 72 sites, 50-amp electric, dump, reservable. Added $35 non-electric / $40 electric (2026 page), season Mar 1 - Nov 30, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/potable water/store, 14-night max, Firefly link. Cleared the 50-ft max_rig_ft (note prose, stated on no official page). Water at the site not stated.
